name: Runemaster audit #2730: Speedy Attuner raises move speed and cuts Runic Tattoo mana cost
contract: Speedy Attuner rank1 705554: 'Increases your movement speed by 8% and reduces the mana cost of your Runic
Tattoos by 25%.' Rank2 707746: 15% / 50%. Re-verified in Spell.dbc: both ranks' Effect0 is
HandleAuraModIncreaseSpeed). Effect1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), MiscValue 14 = SPELLMOD_COST,
mask2(effect1) 16416 (0x4020) on family 38. Runic Tattoos: Earth 801094 carries SpellFamilyName 38,
SpellFamilyFlags[2] 16386 (0x4002), which shares bit 0x4000 with mask2 - a confirmed match - and has
ManaCostPercentage 30 (a real percentage-based cost, the kind SPELLMOD_COST reduces). SPELLMOD_COST is
applied generically inside SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost; no occurrence of 705554/707746 exists in
src/server/coa/. Expected: each rank raises run speed by its percentage and cuts 801094's power cost
